records.name: Community Health and Gardens
records.summary: A Philadelphia health group that runs a community garden where neighbors grow vegetables, with a focus on healthy eating and exercise.
records.what_you_do: Grow vegetables in the community garden. The site also lists one-off events such as a harvest day, a fun fair, and a first aid class, but it does not say how to sign up for them.

schedule.text: No regular garden hours are published. The site lists one-off events, but the event list shows no year and no times.

records.name: Fellowship of Women Clergy
records.summary: A Christian network based in Philadelphia that supports women in ministry with leadership training and peer support.
records.what_you_do: Join the monthly online gatherings or the in-person gatherings in Philadelphia, which are held quarterly, and sign up for the mailing list to hear about them.

schedule.text: An online gathering every month and an in-person gathering every quarter in Philadelphia. Dates are posted on the group's upcoming gatherings page.

first_step.how: RSVP for the next gathering using the form on fellowshipofwomenclergy.org, then sign up for the mailing list
first_step.basis: Gatherings are announced publicly with an RSVP form, though the page does not say whether women who are not clergy may attend.

records.notes: Homepage read on the www form (the bare domain timed out twice). No dated events or news on the homepage, so status is probably_active (working site, no dates). The Upcoming Gatherings and mailing list pages were linked but not read. The Charity ID printed on the page (84-2384240) matches the IRS EIN. Facebook, Instagram and YouTube are named on the site but no links were recorded. Volunteer roles are not described.

records.name: Gifted Scholars Leadership Program
records.summary: A nonprofit that supports girls of color through mentoring and scholarships, from middle school through graduate school. It is also planning a residential learning community for girls in foster care or facing homelessness.
records.what_you_do: Girls can apply for the scholarships. Adults can volunteer on the advisory committee for the planned leadership academy, in fields such as education, child welfare, mental health, law, finance, and fundraising.

first_step.how: Message the group on Instagram to ask about joining the advisory committee, or check the scholarships page for the next application
first_step.basis: Scholarships need an application, and the volunteer role starts with a message, so the way in is not fully open.

records.notes: Homepage read (one fetch). The newest dated item is a scholarship deadline of July 17, 2026, so last_sign_of_life uses the month of that deadline, not a post date. 2026 winners were announced (no month given). The Howley ASPIRE nurse program is promoted on the site, but the page does not say this group runs it, so it is not recorded here (see leads_only). No phone or email is published. The Instagram link is built from the handle @giftedscholars printed on the site. Community tags are empty because no tag covers girls of color. The IRS address (7474 Rhoads St) is not published because the site shows no address.

records.name: Community Empowerment Organization (CEO)
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that helps families build self-sufficiency. Its youth program, running since 1997, works to keep students in school, and it runs a 2026 voter engagement effort.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers can reach out through the site's Volunteer link to help with the youth program or the voter work. The site lists no meeting times or event dates.

first_step.how: Email info@ceo1.org or use the Volunteer link on ceo1.org to ask how to help
first_step.basis: The site gives a plain contact route for volunteers, though it lists no schedule or sign-up steps.

records.notes: The website ceo1.org belongs to the Community Empowerment Organization (CEO). The IRS filing under the name KWJ Community Outreach lists this website and the same contact name as the book author on the site, so this record treats them as one group. Please confirm before publishing. The IRS address is an apartment unit on City Avenue, probably a home, so no location is published. The only 2026 evidence is a menu item, 'Voter Engagement 2026', with no month or details, so last_sign_of_life is left out.
